title: AutoFeed (GrapeGAF)
description: GrapeGAF​ is a lightweight survival utility plugin designed for Minecraft 1.21. It introduces a seamless Auto-Feed system, allowing players to focus on their adventures while the plugin manages their nutrition automatically.
body:
GrapeGAF is a lightweight survival utility plugin designed for Minecraft 1.21. It introduces a seamless Auto-Feed system, allowing players to focus on their adventures while the plugin manages their nutrition automatically.
​
Main Features:
Intelligent Auto-Feeding: Automatically detects when a player's hunger bar drops and consumes available food from the inventory.

Zero-Lag Performance: Highly optimized code designed to run in the background without affecting your server's TPS.

Seamless Integration: Works out of the box with the latest Spigot and Paper 1.21 versions.

Survival Ready: Perfect for survival, build-heavy, or RPG servers where constant inventory management can be a distraction.

Smart Food Selection: Intelligently uses food items based on your survival needs.

Plug & Play: No complex setup required. Install and let the plugin handle the rest.
Bilingual Support: Clean messaging and support, compatible with both English and Spanish speaking communities.

Installation:
1) Download the GrapeGAF.jar.
2) Drop it into your server's /plugins folder.
3) Restart your server.
4) Enjoy!
